items.text: Eagles TE Dallas Goedert suffered sprained MCL; expected to miss a few weeks per tests.
items.why: Sprained MCL suffered vs Titans; did not return
items.implication: Eagles TE production drop; possible Ertz or other TE bump
items.opportunity: Increased targets to Eagles WRs (Smith etc) or RB checkdowns

items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels underwent imaging on dislocated left elbow; Marcus Mariota expected to start Sunday vs Seattle as team consults experts. Prior similar injury cost ~4 weeks.
items.why: Dislocated left elbow (reinjury); X-rays negative but imaging/protocol ongoing
items.implication: Mariota starts; Commanders pass game downgrade near-term
items.opportunity: Backup QB and WRs/TEs may see adjusted roles if offense slows

items.text: Bears HC Ben Johnson: Caleb Williams week-to-week with hamstring after MRI; will miss some time. Tyson Bagent is backup.
items.why: Hamstring pull suffered scrambling; carted off, MRI Monday
items.implication: Bagent likely starts multi-week; Bears offense downgrade
items.opportunity: Bears skill players face volume/efficiency hit without dual-threat QB

items.text: Ladd McConkey officially ACTIVE (cracked rib, flak jacket possible). RJ Harvey inactive.
items.why: McConkey optimism confirmed active; Harvey hamstring inactive
items.implication: McConkey startable with docks; grab Jonah Coleman as Harvey handcuff/stash
items.opportunity: Coleman elevated role with Harvey out

items.text: Chargers placing TEs David Njoku (fibula) and Charlie Kolar (forearm) on IR.
items.why: Injuries left early Week 2; IR moves
items.implication: Orande Gadsden (29 snaps/15 routes Week 2) elevated TE1 role
items.opportunity: Gadsden waiver/stream TE upside with Herbert

items.text: Packers WR Jayden Reed injured back Sunday; spent night in NJ, returning to GB for evaluation of treatment/recovery timeline.
items.implication: Likely misses time; Packers WR depth tested
items.opportunity: Boost to other GB WRs/TEs if multi-week

items.text: Bucky Irving separating from Kenny Gainwell: out-snapped 51-23, carries 17-2, routes 22-12. Through 2 weeks opps 36-12. Tucker active but 0 snaps.
items.implication: Irving locked as primary TB RB; Gainwell clear backup
items.opportunity: Irving every-week RB2/flex with goal-line/third-down work

items.text: Rhamondre Stevenson lost another fumble (7th in 31 games) and was punished with playing time. NE needs TreVeyon Henderson explosiveness often, especially with AJ Brown out.
items.why: Fumble discipline + Brown absence creates need for Henderson
items.implication: Henderson more involved ROS even if Stevenson retains lead; both viable
items.opportunity: Henderson routes/carries upside in weapon-thin NE offense

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley to undergo MRI after stinger; hope is minor as he played through it with neck roll after missing most of first half.
items.why: Stinger on first play; returned second half but limited; MRI cautionary
items.implication: Likely plays Week 3 but monitor practice; Bigsby/Shipley got work
items.opportunity: If limited/out, Tank Bigsby primary early-down beneficiary

items.text: 49ers HC Kyle Shanahan: Mike Evans hip injury not believed serious; could have returned in Q4 if needed. Demarcus Robinson high ankle sprain.
items.why: Hip injury in-game; Shanahan optimistic postgame
items.implication: Evans expected available Week 3 with minimal docks

items.text: Sunday injuries watching: Caleb Williams (hamstring), Jayden Daniels (elbow), Saquon Barkley (stinger), Jadarian Price (chest), Jayden Reed (head), Dallas Goedert (knee), Mike Evans (hip not serious), plus others (Brooks, Dowdle, Dobbins, Njoku/Kolar).
items.why: Postgame compilation of key fantasy injuries
items.opportunity: Handcuffs and backups for OUT/limited cases

items.text: Zay Flowers (hamstring) OUT. Michael Pittman (foot) OUT.
items.implication: Ravens/Colts WR depth charts shift; backups elevated
items.opportunity: Secondary WRs/TEs (e.g. Likely, Bernard) for volume

items.text: Puka Nacua (hip) true GAME-TIME DECISION. Ladd McConkey optimism (cracked rib).
items.why: Hip; no practice stretch, true GTD per reports
items.implication: Have pivot ready; if out, TE/WR depth (Mumpfield etc) rises

items.text: DeVonta Smith RIDE OR DIE: 27% and 38% target shares first two games; leads all WRs in expected PPR points this week per model.
items.why: Elite target share and expected points early
items.opportunity: Continued high volume with Goedert potentially out
